mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.type, p.leaf_category_id, p.l2_category_id, p.title, p.price, p.price_unit, p.`desc` AS description, p.template_values, p.lng, p.lat, p.address, p.completeness_level, p.status, p.status_reason, p.created_at, p.expire_at, p.version, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, u.realname_status AS author_realname_status FROM post p JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{postId}
SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM contact_event WHERE post_id IN #{pid} GROUP BY post_id
